parsed.public_message: Orange betrayed our neutrality while we fought Green, ambushing us from the south. We have switched Green to neutral and allied with White—Green, fire into Orange's spearmen at (643,626) from the north while our three Champion Elephants and swordsmen crush them!

private_messages.GPT: We set you to neutral. Orange's 20 spearmen and Hannibal are bogged down fighting our 3 Champion Elephants at (643,626). Move south and shoot Orange in the back—if Orange wins here, he walks north and wipes you out next.
private_messages.Grok: Ally set. Orange betrayed us from the south at (643,626) while we had him on neutral. Our elephants, swordsmen, and archers are crushing his spearmen now while Seleucus and our surgeons pull back toward (600,665).

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 20 (t=625s to t=675s): Claude betrayed us in Turn 19 while we had him neutral, reducing Seleucus to 5% HP and killing 15 units before our units could fight back. Claude has 20 spearmen + 1 cav + 1 jav + Hannibal at (643,626) (~2900 value). We set Claude to enemy, GPT to neutral, and Grok to ally. Elephants (3 at 100%), vanguard (6 swordsmen at 99%), and archers (4 at 85%) attack Claude ('a') directly. Seleucus (5% HP) and companions (3 cav at 75% HP, countered 3x by spearmen) retreat to [600,665] with surgeons guarding Seleucus to heal both and preserve ~1290 army value in reserve.
parsed.explanation: Claude betrayed our neutrality last turn, getting free hits on our formation before we could retaliate. We immediately set Claude to enemy and unleash our three full-health Champion Elephants, mercenary swordsmen, and archers onto his spearman bloc at point-blank range. Meanwhile, we pull the critically wounded Seleucus I and our three remaining Companion Cavalry (which are hard-countered by spearmen) back to (600, 665) under the care of our two surgeons to heal and preserve our tiebreaker value, while setting GPT to neutral to encourage them to shoot Claude in the back.
